text:
Simone: heads up — CI red on the midnight model-sync/bench job (cron run). failed in eval-suite on the new commit a1b2c3d
Chris: saw it, rerun button? any obvious logs?
Simone: here's the tail from the worker:
```
ERROR: failed to assemble checkpoint shards: S3Error: NotFound
  at model-sync/download.js:87:23
  at async Promise.all (index 0)
```
Maya: that stack looks like parallel downloader hit a missing shard, probably a race after the uploader moved parts. which region/queue?
Simone: us-west-2, pool p4-long. job id: cron-mid-sync-176945
Arjun: quick test — can someone rerun the single eval job (not whole cron)? sharding often shows up only on full-run. I'll trigger with --keep-artifacts so we can inspect.
deploy-bot: rerun requested by Arjun — job cron-mid-sync-176945 rerun queued (id 1769457001)
Chris: thanks. if it reproduces we should bisect the model-sync change that added parallel downloads last week. suspect commit 7f9e4aa -> a1b2c3d
Maya: agree. also add a small backoff between part requests as a short-term mitigation.
Simone: rerun finished — still failing, same NotFound.
Arjun: ok bisect plan: 1) revert parallel downloader in a branch, 2) run 10 quick evals against same sha range, 3) if repro gone, revert upstream. Who owns revert+test?
Maya: I'll take revert branch + test, will push in ~30m. tagging Chris to review for release risk.
Chris: ack, will review. Also we should add a smoke check to uploader that verifies all parts are present before signalling completion.
Simone: action items: Maya -> revert+test, Chris -> review + uploader smoke check design, Arjun -> collect failing shard list + S3 ops logs. I'll follow up in morning with results :thumbsup:
